body: Israeli airstrikes on Hadatha, southern Lebanon.

body: A female NCO from Unit 8200, identified only as V., was awarded a certificate of appreciation by IDF Chief of Staff Eyal Zamir. Before October 7 she warned that Hamas was ready to launch a large scale surprise attack. IDF Chief of Staff Zamir: "V. is a clear example of intellectual courage and professionalism. title: Trump Says Polls Underestimate MAGA
body: President Trump says polls have “ALWAYS underestimated MAGA,” claiming he won all seven swing states, the popular vote, 86% of counties and 99% of primaries this year. “I AM ON THE BALLOT!”

title: IDF Strike Kills Hamas Operative in Khan Younis
body: The IDF killed Zakar Nabil Musa Kisi, a Hamas Nukhba operative, in a strike in Khan Younis earlier today. The IDF said he took part in the October 7 invasion of Israel and directed the Turkish organization Deniz Feneri, which presents itself as a humanitarian charity while maintaining ties to senior Hamas and Turkish figures.

title: Israeli Cabinet to Discuss Houthis
body: On the agenda for today's Israeli security Cabinet: the Houthis and the latest developments in the Bab el-Mandeb Strait. IDF Central Command is also expected to brief ministers on a plan for escalation in the Judea and Samaria, including the possibility of the Palestinian Authority turning its weapons against Israel. An Israeli official: "Israel needs to be prepared for every possible scenario."

title: Wright: Hormuz Supplies Rising
body: Energy Secretary Wright: "We've got increasing supplies coming out of the Strait of Hormuz, and they've continued to rise."

title: Yemeni Forces Launch Campaign
body: The pro-Saudi Yemeni armed forces have announced the start of a campaign to retake the country and restore state institutions, hours after Rashad al-Alimi's statement.

title: US Backs Saudi Offensive on Houthis
body: Washington is providing intelligence and targeting support to the Saudi-backed offensive against the Houthis, but will not take part in the fighting, Axios reports. Saudi Defense Minister Prince Khalid bin Salman requested U.S. airstrikes from Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth. U.S. officials said there will be no "kinetic action for now."

title: Omani Copilot May Face Death Penalty
body: Omani copilot Hamam al-Hammami, accused of attempting to crash a flydubai flight bound for Israel, could face the death penalty in the UAE, a senior Emirati source told Ynet. Israeli intelligence officials are taking part in the investigation inside the UAE.

title: أزمة رونالدو.. مغادرة جديدة لمعسكر البرتغال
body: تواصلت تداعيات خروج كريستيانو رونالدو من معسكر منتخب بلاده البرتغال خلال فترة التوقف الدولي، حيث ذكر تقرير إخباري أن رونالدو لم يكن الوحيد الذي غادر المعسكر.

title: وسائل إعلام إيرانية: استقالة وزير النفط
body: أفادت وسائل إعلام رسمية إيرانية، الأحد، باستقالة وزير النفط محسن باك نجاد، وستولي حامد بوفارد، الرئيس التنفيذي لشركة النفط الوطنية الإيرانية المملوكة للدولة، منصب القائم بأعمال الوزير.

title: أكثر من 70 قتيلا في معارك بين القوات اليمنية والحوثيين بتعز
body: قُتل أكثر من 70 شخصا، الأحد، في اشتباكات بين القوات الحكومية والحوثيين في محافظة تعز جنوب غربي اليمن خلال الساعات الأربع والعشرين الماضية، وفق ما أفادته به وكالة فرانس برس.

title: مصادر أمنية: الجيش الأميركي ينشر قرابة 3000 جندي في إسرائيل
body: أفاد موقع والا الإسرائيلي، الأحد، نقلا عن مصادر أمنية بأن الجيش الأميركي ينشر حاليا قرابة 3 آلاف جندي في إسرائيل.

title: الجيش الإسرائيلي: نبني استراتيجية لمواجهة "حرب مفاجئة"
body: أفاد الجيش الإسرائيلي، الأحد، بأنه يبني استراتيجية تنطلق من الاستعداد لحرب مفاجئة، مؤكدا أن الجيش في حالة تأهب دائم لمنع المفاجآت والاستعداد لها.

title: دمشق: ندين استكمال إسرائيل العمل في "خط سوفا 53"
body: دانت سوريا الانتهاكات الإسرائيلية داخل أراضيها، منددة باستكمال العمل في ما يسمى "خط سوفا 53"، والذي اعتبرته خرقا واضحا لاتفاقية فصل القوات لعام 1974 وانتهاكا صارخا لقرارات الشرعية الدولية.

title: محمد بن زايد وجورجيا ميلوني يبحثان التطورات الإقليمية
body: بحث الشيخ محمد بن زايد آل نهيان رئيس رئيس دولة الإمارات العربية المتحدة، وجورجيا ميلوني رئيسة وزراء الجمهورية الإيطالية، الأحد، خلال اتصال هاتفي، مختلف مسارات التعاون والعمل المشترك بين البلدين وسبل تعزيزها، خاصة في المجالات الاقتصادية والتنموية بما يخدم مصالحهما المشتركة، وذلك في إطار الشراكة الاستراتيجية التي تجمع البلدين.

title: نتنياهو: أعداؤنا يهددون مجالنا البحري في المتوسط
body: قال رئيس الوزراء الإسرائيلي بنيامين نتنياهو، الأحد، إن المجال البحري بات ساحة لمعركة دولية، لا سيما في مضيق هرمز وباب المندب، مشيرا إلى وجود تهديد للمجال البحري الإسرائيلي في البحر المتوسط.

title: اليمن.. الانتقالي الجنوبي يعلن إقامة "مليونية" في عدن
body: أعلن المجلس الانتقالي الجنوبي في اليمن، الأحد، إقامة مليونية مركزية في العاصمة عدن وجميع محافظات الجنوب، بهدف "الدفاع عن الجنوب ومشروعه الوطني" وحماية "مكتسبات الشعب الجنوبي".

title: زيلينسكي: بوتين يريد إضعاف مقاومة أوكرانيا بالغارات الجوية
body: قال الرئيس الأوكراني فولوديمير زيلينسكي، الأحد، إن نظيره الروسي فلاديمير بوتين يحاول إضعاف المقاومة الأوكرانية من خلال تصعيد الغارات الجوية على العاصمة كييف ومدن أخرى.

title: مصادر يمنية: الحوثيون يدخلون مدينة التربة جنوبي تعز
body: أفادت مصادر يمنية، يوم الأحد، بأن الحوثيين دخلوا مدينة التربة جنوبي تعز، بعد فرار قائد ما يعرف بمحور طور الباحة إلى مدينة عدن.

title: Ansarallah extends gains in Yemen's Taiz
body: Yemen's Ansarallah made fresh territorial gains in the southwestern province of Taiz on Sunday, pressing its advance as the Saudi-backed government in Yemen announced the start of a large-scale military campaign to retake what it called the remaining Ansarallah-held areas.

title: Isfahan children’s film festival opens with tribute to young martyrs
body: TEHRAN- The 38th edition of the International Film Festival for Children and Youth of Isfahan opened on Saturday with a ceremony honoring child and adolescent martyrs, attended by festival secretary Hamed Jafari, Isfahan Mayor Ali Qassemzadeh, members of the City Council and municipal officials.

title: Saeidi Brothers release reimagined folk single “Sar-e Dast-e Yarom”
body: TEHRAN- Iranian traditional vocalist brothers Ali and Mohammad Saeidi have released their latest single, “Sar-e Dast-e Yarom” (“My Beloved’s Cuff”), a reimagined version of an old Iranian folk song.

title: Iran’s “The Long Winter” wins award at Eurasia documentary festival
body: TEHRAN- Iranian documentary “The Long Winter”, directed by Hassan Jafari, won the Best Film Award at the 10th International Documentary Film Festival of CIS Countries “Eurasia.Doc,” which concluded in Minsk, Belarus, on October 2.

title: Iran marks historic milestones in space industry, expands indigenous satellite capabilities
body: TEHRAN — Iran has achieved a series of historic milestones in its space industry over the past two years, advancing indigenous satellite development, launch vehicle capabilities and the commercial application of space technology, according to the head of the Iranian Space Agency (ISA).

title: Iran rejects Axios report on expulsion of diplomats from US
body: TEHRAN — Iran has rejected a report by the US news website Axios claiming that two members of its delegation to the United Nations General Assembly left New York after failing to comply with a US State Department request to leave the country, with Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi describing the alleged “expulsion” as a sign of “desperation and defeat.”

title: Iran refutes ‘Big Lies’ on nuclear program, drug production
body: TEHRAN— Iran’s Permanent Mission to the United Nations and other international organizations in Vienna has rejected US allegations that Iran was producing drugs at its nuclear facilities, describing the claim as another “BIG LIE” aimed at creating pretexts for aggression against the country.

title: Iran hails departure of US forces from Iraq
body: TEHRAN — Iran has welcomed the departure of US and other foreign forces from Iraq after two decades, describing the development as an important and necessary step toward strengthening national sovereignty, territorial integrity and independence in the Arab country.

title: Medvedev vows Russia will never sacrifice strategic partnership with Iran
body: TEHRAN- Former Russian President Dmitry Medvedev has said the aggression against Iran has had serious consequences for the global economy, with people in the United States feeling the impact at home.

title: American Marine arrested over brutal murder of Japanese woman in Okinawa
body: TEHRAN — Japanese authorities lodged a formal protest with Washington on Sunday after Okinawa police arrested a 20-year-old U.S. Marine on suspicion of robbing and murdering a local woman in Naha, reigniting fury over the massive American military footprint in Japan.

title: Israel blows up schools, flattens villages in southern Lebanon
body: TEHRAN — Israeli forces escalated their campaign of artillery shelling, airstrikes, and controlled demolitions across southern Lebanon over the weekend, turning border villages into uninhabitable wreckage while Washington provides political cover for the ongoing aggression.

title: India’s new ambassador pledges to unlock ‘huge potential’ in Iran trade ties
body: TEHRAN — India’s new ambassador to Iran has emphasized the scope for expanding bilateral trade as one of his core missions, pledging to facilitate business matchmaking and explore mechanisms to overcome logistics and banking hurdles, particularly for humanitarian and essential goods.

title: Iran says to deliver additional points on US counter-proposal
body: TEHRAN — Iran will convey additional points regarding a US counter-proposal to Tehran’s seven-day plan for reopening the Strait of Hormuz after completing the necessary assessments, Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baqaei said on Sunday.

title: Qalibaf: Iran ready to spring new surprises on adversaries
body: TEHRAN — Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf has warned that Iran will continue to confront its adversaries with new surprises while pursuing military and diplomatic strategies in parallel, saying the United States has grown frustrated by the Iranian nation’s steadfast resistance.

title: Keyhan: Strait of Hormuz exposes America's economic problems
body: In a note, Keyhan argued that the continued closure of the Strait of Hormuz has directly affected the US economy by driving up inflation and fuel prices. The newspaper said President Trump and his administration are working hard to prevent Republicans from losing the November midterm elections, which it says have become closely tied to the conflict with Iran and its economic consequences.

title: Iran vows stronger response to military attack
body: TEHRAN — Iran is ready for a diplomatic solution to its conflict with the US, but if Washington again chooses a military course, Tehran is more prepared than before to defend itself and will deliver a stronger response, Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said Sunday.

title: Green Party recognizes Zionism as a form of racism
body: The Green Party of England and Wales has voted to declare Zionism a form of racism in an unprecedented move at its party conference in Brighton, Middle East Eye has learnt.
